metadata.description:
The Game is Ripped from chomikuj website, Made by {Don't know} This CD was released by{Don't know but probably in 2000's}, Full working Polish version with Polish subtitles and dialogues.

Tested it on Windows 10 and Windows XP

To run the game first install the Adobe Shockwave Player 12.3 included in the folder, Then run SPR.exe and select the levels, I also included more Shockwave Projectors for me PJ101 worked the best but you have to install the Demo and then copy files over, SPRS.exe works in Fullscreen
